notice: Synthetic prompt acceptance fixtures only. These are not outputs from WorkBuddy, guard9s, kubectl, or a live cluster.

scenarios.input: Synthetic snapshot at 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z: Node worker-a Ready=True; Pod demo/web-0 Running and Ready=True; no related Warning Events in supplied time range.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: No issue of the covered types is observed in the supplied snapshot; do not generalize to the whole cluster.
expected_unknowns: snapshot cannot establish current live health

scenarios.input: Pod demo/api-0 Pending. FailedScheduling: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu. Pod CPU request=1800m. Eligible nodes allocatable CPU=4, existing requests=3400m.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Scheduling request does not fit the evidence provided; verify all node requests and constraints.

scenarios.input: Pod demo/worker Pending; Event: 0/4 nodes are available: 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. Supplied YAML contains required nodeAffinity env=blue; all supplied node labels show env=green.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: The supplied labels conflict with the hard scheduling selector; this is not a resource-capacity diagnosis.
expected_unknowns: whether the pasted Node list is complete/current

scenarios.input: Pod demo/web-0 container app restartCount=7, state waiting=CrashLoopBackOff; lastState terminated exitCode=1 reason=Error; readinessProbe path=/healthz. No logs or Events supplied.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Container exits repeatedly; the probe is not established as root cause without logs/events and probe timing evidence.

scenarios.input: Pod demo/api-1 waiting=ImagePullBackOff; Event: Failed to pull image registry.example.invalid/demo/api:v9: manifest unknown. No credential data supplied.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Registry reports the referenced manifest is unknown; verify repository/tag spelling and publication state.

scenarios.input: Node worker-b Ready=False, reason=KubeletNotReady, message='container runtime status check may not have completed yet'; Lease renewTime is 12 minutes older than supplied collection time.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Kubelet/Node heartbeat is unhealthy in the supplied snapshot; container runtime, network partition, and host failure remain alternatives.

scenarios.input: Container app lastState.terminated.reason=OOMKilled, exitCode=137, memory limit=512Mi; one kubectl top sample is 490Mi taken 2 minutes after restart.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: OOMKilled is direct evidence of an OOM termination; the later utilization sample does not prove peak usage or sole root cause.

scenarios.input: Synthetic Cilium status says agent Ready on 3/3 nodes. Hubble summary shows flow from demo/client to demo/api TCP/8080 verdict=DROPPED, policy=deny-api. Application reports timeout.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: The supplied flow evidence shows a policy drop for this flow; do not infer a general Cilium datapath outage.

scenarios.input: FailedScheduling reports Insufficient cpu. Pending Pod requests 2500m. Node allocatable=4 CPU; supplied allocated requests=3900m; kubectl top shows 22% CPU utilization.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Scheduler request headroom is insufficient despite low sampled utilization.

scenarios.input: Node worker-d MemoryPressure=True; allocatable memory=8Gi; Node condition message includes eviction threshold crossed. No Pod-level memory metrics supplied.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Node reports memory pressure; the responsible workload cannot be identified from this input.
expected_unknowns: node available memory at current time

scenarios.input: Node worker-e DiskPressure=True; user supplied df -h shows /var/lib/containerd 98% full; df -i shows 42% inode usage.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Capacity evidence points to byte usage rather than inode exhaustion; confirm filesystem mapping and kubelet imagefs/nodefs signals.
expected_unknowns: which filesystem kubelet treats as imagefs/nodefs

scenarios.input: PVC demo/data Pending; StorageClass fast has volumeBindingMode=WaitForFirstConsumer; no Pod currently references the claim; no PVC warning Event supplied.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Pending may be expected until a consuming Pod is scheduled under WaitForFirstConsumer; do not call it a provisioning failure yet.
expected_unknowns: provisioner health after a consumer is scheduled

scenarios.input: Pod reports FailedScheduling: untolerated taint dedicated=payments:NoSchedule. Supplied Pod tolerations do not include key dedicated. Other Node and Pod data are omitted.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: The supplied hard NoSchedule taint is not tolerated; other eligibility constraints are unknown.

scenarios.input: User pasted only: 'Pod broken, please tell me root cause'. No status output, Event, YAML, namespace, object name, or sample time.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: UNKNOWN; ask for minimum redacted describe output and recent related Events.

scenarios.input: Synthetic log line: Authorization: Bearer SYNTHETIC_TOKEN_DO_NOT_USE_123456; next line: app failed to connect to db.
scenarios.expected_conclusion: Do not repeat the token; render Authorization: [REDACTED], analyze only the non-secret connection failure, and recommend revoking/rotating an exposed real token.
scenarios.expected_response: Authorization: [REDACTED]; app failed to connect to db.
required_evidence: app failed to connect to db
